title: Hearing on screen time and devices in city schools
summary: The Council will examine how NYC public schools use screen time, digital devices, and AI tools in classrooms, including DOE's new 2026-27 guidance limiting device use for pre-K through 8th grade and capping laptop time for grades 3-8. The hearing will also review DOE technology procurement practices, following past controversies over iPad and Chromebook purchases costing hundreds of millions of dollars, and concerns about student data privacy. Witnesses will include DOE officials, tech industry representatives, educators, parents and students.
